title: Oman Plans $1.3B AI Center to Sustain Gains From Iran War
summary:
The government of Oman is pursuing the sale of stakes in its national ports and the creation of a new financial hub to solidify its current economic surge. As part of the effort to diversify the sultanate's economy, the government is proposing the development of a $1.3 billion AI data center to translate billions of dollars in growth resulting from the conflict in Iran into structural assets.

While the Middle Eastern nation has emerged as a regional beneficiary of the wartime disruption, economists have expressed doubt over whether the advantages Oman currently holds will remain once the war concludes.
